bonuses.name: 'Ere We Go!
bonuses.text: If this Threat is Engaged at the start of its Turn, it gains +2 damage to melee attacks.

bonuses.name: Kombi-Rokkit
bonuses.text: The Big Mek can Multi Attack with their Shoota and Rokkit Launcher. If they do, they make their Attack Test with an additional +1 DV penalty.

bonuses.name: Kombi-skorcha
bonuses.text: The Big Mek can Multi Attack with their Skorcha and Shoota. If they do, they make their Attack Test with an additional +1 DV penalty.

bonuses.name: Grot Oiler
bonuses.text: The Big Mek reduces the DV or a repair test by 2. This destroys the Grot Oiler.

bonuses.name: Speed
bonuses.text: Speed is printed as "4 (May not Run or Sprint)".

abilities.name: Mekanik
abilities.text: A Big Mek can attempt to repair any damaged piece of equipment with the ORK Keyword within 1 metre as a Simple Action. They can also Reload a weapon as a Free Action.

abilities.name: Orky Upgradez
abilities.text: As a Free Action, the Mek may spend 1 Ruin to tinker with a ranged weapon within 1 metre. The weapon gains +1d3 ED and +1d3 AP for its next attack. The next time the weapon is fired, a Complication triggers if the Wrath Die lands on a 1, 2, or 3.
